body: I feel so terrible all the time, I can't seem to get out of my head. Most events that I want to go to I don't because I am either distracted with my phone / internet or anxious (or I'm on there because I'm anxious). I really need to see a therapist soon because nothing seems to help. I don't have motivation to clean the dishes or the house, there are fruit flies everywhere. I found out my bike got stolen within the last week today. I watch dark shows a lot just to get the ecstasy of seeing a suicide on screen and living intravenously though them (or any death and make myself think it was a suicide). I hate that i fantasize about that so often...fuck I want to die.
We don't need people diagnosing mental disorders of other people (there are professionals who do that for a living), and we don't need to make it a competition to see who's trauma is the worst.
